matches.quote: The "optical melting" claim does not exclude heating, photodoping or probe artefacts... it says nothing about the electron temperature, which the authors acknowledge may be higher
Figs. 1c, 2d, 3b,c, 4a,b and S4–S10 use top-gate voltage as the x-axis. Please add a calibrated density axis so that... Fig. 2b can be compared directly.
The SI model (section 1) is a single Einstein oscillator... The WC has a gapless acoustic phonon continuum, and a sideband coupled to it would generally be broad
extract WP peak positions with error bars against calibrated density... show whether the WP splitting extrapolates to zero at the onset of doping
under optical pumping (p. 6, Figs. 4a,b, S6, S10) the umklapp "nearly vanishes" at ~4000 nW while the WPs "remain robust"... survive melting of the lattice
state how many devices and locations show the umklapp and WP features, show the key maps (Figs. 1c, 2d) for at least one more device or spot
melting at r_s ≈ 12 (κ = 4.5, m_e = 0.4 m0) is a factor ~3 below the clean-limit value of ~31–38... attributed to disorder... without a test.
show that the effect reverses with pump helicity and is absent under linear pumping; specify the probe polarization and the "no pumping" detection configuration
The hBN thicknesses, gate-to-sample distances and onset voltage are not given... They also decide whether gate screening matters... changing both the melting density and the WP stiffness
"Ultrafast optical control" (abstract, conclusion) is not demonstrated: no time-resolved measurement is reported and the pulses are ~200 ps. Please rephrase.

notes: C7 is marked 'partly' because P19 questions the unexpectedly low melting r_s ~ 12 (high critical density with m_e = 0.4 m0) and the untested disorder explanation, without explicitly framing it as a comparison against MoSe2. C12 is marked 'partly' because P5 and P1 point out the absence of time-resolved or separated pump-probe measurements and P7 challenges the claim to 'reveal Wigner crystal dynamics', though the review primarily targets the 'ultrafast' and phonon-assignment claims rather than steady-state spectroscopy per se. C13 is marked 'raised' because P14 explicitly contrasts the local Einstein oscillator model in the SI with the WC's gapless acoustic phonon continuum and asks how the full phonon model produces a sharp WP feature.
